papers.title: AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression
papers.summary: AutoCompress is a hardware-guided compression framework that uses differentiable architecture search and serving-engine cost models to produce heterogeneous LLM architectures meeting latency, throughput, and memory constraints while preserving accuracy.

papers.title: LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
papers.summary: We introduce LongBanana, to our knowledge the first expert-designed and expert-verified benchmark for long-context multi-reference image synthesis in the age of...

papers.title: Static Recovery Is Not Dynamic Stability: Dynamics-Aware Benchmarking of Protein Motif Scaffolding
papers.summary: New benchmarks and molecular dynamics frameworks are presented to rigorously evaluate protein scaffold-generation models by assessing dynamic fidelity and structural stability beyond static success.

papers.title: P^2-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
papers.summary: P$^2$-MOPD jointly optimizes mixing coefficients and student weights under an on-policy distillation objective, allowing experts to act as parameter priors and achieving faster, more balanced recovery than MOPD.

papers.title: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
papers.summary: SplatAnything applies Gaussian Spacing Normalization to canonicalize scene-level Gaussian spacing statistics, improving feed-forward 3DGS reconstruction across varying scene scales and viewpoints.
